goal: Prevent silent loss of pending private broadcast transactions when a node restarts before relay completes
agreement: Concept approval for persisting transactions across restarts (vasild, craigraw)
Nonblocking objection: writing broadcast data to disk risks privacy on non-wallet nodes (tankyleo)
Unaddressed objection: unrestricted file permissions could leak private broadcast data (vasild)
Suggests a broader broadcast pool because a shutdown dump does not handle node crashes (craigraw)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents silent loss of submitted transactions if a node restarts during private relay
Improves relay reliability and liveness for users broadcasting privately over Tor or I2P
